title: 第7章 车速太快了，我得踢石子了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

焦虑、不安，却又对现状没有丝毫改变能力。

面对祖国人，即便是庞然大物般的沃特公司都选择让步，她又能怎样呢？

这巨大的压力下，是持续了一个多月的失眠。

贝卡总是会在莱恩熟睡后借酒与香烟麻痹心神，勉强平复翻涌的情绪。

她暗自细数过，近段时间和祖国人碰面的频次，甚至远超八年前自己担任对方形象负责人时的相处次数。

如果仅仅是面对祖国人，那么她还能承受住心底的恨意，但……

“莱恩——”

贝卡恍惚中，似乎看到了她可爱的儿子彻底脱离她的庇护，独自面对那个毫无人性的、冷血暴虐的恶棍的画面。

毫无疑问。

莱恩被她养育得很好，完全是她期盼的样子。

善良、懂事、乖巧、贴心…

无论用什么美好的词汇形容莱恩，贝卡都不觉得过分。

可是……

“他被祖国人影响到了，但他的纯善底色却又和祖国人格格不入。”

“或早或晚，他们之间必然会争执、闹翻。”

“我的莱恩会有危险！”

忽然，就在贝卡即将沉思着点燃一根烟时，她发现停放在路旁的车子居然没有关门。

难道是最近压力大，神思恍惚忘记关上了吗？

贝卡并未多想，拿上车钥匙便出门关锁。

回归黑袍纠察队的比利·布切尔再一次独自离队，他的成员们也早就习以为常，最多问上一句去做什么。

但以屠夫比利的性格，他肯定会回一句：小北鼻离开爸爸就不知道该怎么做了吗？

之后，他便迫不及待地赶去沃特公司藏匿妻子贝卡的隐秘据点。

这份藏身地点的情报，源自他昔日在CIA的上司格蕾丝·马洛里，交换条件是帮对方调查二流英雄自由女，至于背后的真实意图马洛里并未吐露分毫。

眼下的比利根本就无心深究其中细节，他索性把这些繁杂事务统统丢给小队成员处理。

他的心中，只揣着一份滚烫又焦灼的思念，满心满念都只想尽快见到贝卡。

潜入这里轻而易举，但遍布整个房子周围，乃至整个社区的监控又让比利不敢轻举妄动，他只能

等待的每一分每一秒都格外煎熬。

可为了妻子的安危，他只能按捺下来，幸好时间不久，住宅门口便传来响动。

有脚步声，一定是贝卡！

突如其来的期盼瞬间攫住了比利心神，他激动得四肢微微发麻。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Anxious and restless, but unable to change the status quo at all.

Facing the people of the motherland, even the behemoth Walter Corporation chose to give in, so what could she do?

Under this huge pressure, I suffered from insomnia for more than a month.

Beca would always use alcohol and cigarettes to numb her mind after Ryan fell asleep, barely calming down the surging emotions.

She has secretly counted the number of times she has met people from her motherland in recent times, which even far exceeds the number of times she met eight years ago when she was the person in charge of their image.

If she only faced the people of her motherland, then she could still bear the hatred in her heart, but...

"Ryan——"

In a trance, Beca seemed to see a picture of her lovely son completely leaving her protection and facing the inhumane, cold-blooded and violent villain alone.

There is no doubt about it.

Ryan was raised well by her, exactly as she expected him to be.

Kind, sensible, well-behaved, considerate...

No matter what beautiful words are used to describe Ryan, Beca doesn't think it's too much.

But...

"He was influenced by the people of the motherland, but his pure and kind background was incompatible with the people of the motherland."

"Sooner or later, they are bound to quarrel and fall out."

"My Ryan is in danger!"

Suddenly, just when Beca was about to light a cigarette thoughtfully, she discovered that the car parked on the roadside had not closed the door.

Could it be that you have been under a lot of pressure recently and have been in a trance and forgot to turn it off?

Beca didn't think much, took the car keys and went out to lock the car.

Billy Butcher, who returned to the Black Robe Pickets, once again left the team alone. His members had long been accustomed to it, and at most they asked what they were doing.

But with Billy the Butcher’s character, he would definitely reply: Doesn’t Xiao Beibi not know what to do after leaving his father?

After that, he couldn't wait to rush to the secret stronghold where Walter Company was hiding his wife Becca.

This information about the hiding place came from his former boss at the CIA, Grace Mallory, in exchange for helping the other party investigate the second-rate hero Free Girl. As for the true intention behind it, Mallory did not reveal anything.

At the moment, Billy had no intention of delving into the details. He simply left all these complicated matters to the team members to handle.

In his heart, there was only a hot and anxious longing, and all he wanted was to see Beka as soon as possible.

Sneaking into this place is easy, but the surveillance around the entire house and even the entire community makes Billy dare not act rashly. He can only

Every minute and every second of waiting was excruciating.

But for the safety of his wife, he could only hold back. Fortunately, not long after, there was a noise at the door of the house.

There are footsteps, it must be Becca!

The sudden anticipation seized Billy's mind instantly, and his limbs were slightly numb with excitement.
